title: How --json, --line, --here and a run id combine
body:
**Chose:** `--json` and `--line` conflict with each other, and `--here` conflicts with a run id (clap rejects either pair). With `--json` or `--line`, an unknown run id prints `no run <id>` to stderr, nothing to stdout, and exits 1.
**Over:** letting the last flag win, filtering a named run by `--here`, or printing the prose `no run` listing to stdout as plain `status` does.
**Because:** a consumer parsing stdout must never get prose in place of JSON, and `--here` only narrows a listing.
**Undo:** drop the `conflicts_with` attributes and the stderr branch in `src/cli/status.rs`.

title: Edit the CI workflow to install claude and run the extended gate
body:
**Chose:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml` gains `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.312` right after Node setup, and the gate step now runs the new `docs/project.toml` gate verbatim.
**Over:** leaving CI alone (the Autonomy contract lists CI workflow files under "never").
**Because:** §8 FR-6 names this exact change, and the PRD outranks that list for a file it names; doing it as written needs an AD marked decide.
**Undo:** revert the two lines in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.

title: When the mod polls, and what the pane shows after a failed poll
body:
**Chose:** the first poll runs as the session starts, then every 10 s; a poll that is still running when the next is due skips that tick. After a failed poll the pane shows `factory: <error>` and the band draws nothing.
**Over:** a first poll only after 10 s; overlapping polls; the pane saying `no live run in this repo` while factory is failing.
**Because:** the slice is silent on these. A blank status line for 10 s after start looks broken, overlapping `factory` processes pile up when one is slow, and "no live run" would be a false statement when the poll failed.
**Undo:** drop `void poll()` and the `isPolling` guard in `mods/cockpit/hooks/register.tsx`; render the empty-runs text when `error` is set.

title: The 2.1.312 mod types are not on disk until a hot-reloading session loads the mod
body: `claude -p --plugin-dir` and `claude plugin test` do not write `.claude-plugin/types/`; the types file, `reference.md` and the plugin-authoring SKILL.md sit zstd-compressed in the `claude` binary: scan it for the `28 b5 2f fd` frame magic, `zstd -dc` each, and keep the frame holding `'process.run'`. The authoring examples (band.tsx, pane.tsx, pane.test.tsx) are plain text in `strings` output. Type-check with the tsconfig in the types file header, kept outside the mod, via `npx -p typescript@5 tsc -p`.
